name: qiaopi
title_zh: 一句话白话文，落成南洋阿嬷能读的家书
tagline_zh: 把「今天好想你」翻成南洋华侨寄回故乡的家书，抬头、起兴、嘱咐、落款按干支年排好；说话人和对象不明就先沉浸式反问一次。
tagline_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter a Nanyang emigrant would have sent home: salutation, seasonal opening, instructions, and a sexagenary-cycle sign-off — asking one question first if it cannot place the writer and reader.
desc_en: 把现代的一句话翻译成侨批体（南洋华侨家书风格）的 skill，致敬电影《给阿嬷的情书》
why_zh: 落款绝不写「妾」；历史上侨批必有钱，但你没提寄钱它就不写附银那行——凭空加一句就跳戏。
why_en: The sign-off may never use the self-deprecating "concubine" form. And although real qiaopi always enclosed money, it leaves that line out unless you asked for it — inventing a remittance breaks the letter.
limit_zh: 只做一种语感：潮汕南洋侨批体，以电影《给阿嬷的情书》的诗化句式为骨，不是通用文言翻译器。随件是 1888–1957 年真实侨批和电影里的信，用来学句式、不是史料库。方言只作点缀，不会写成全篇潮汕话。
limit_en: It does one register — Teochew/Nanyang qiaopi, built on the lyric cadence of the 2026 film Letters to Grandma — not general classical Chinese. The bundled references are real 1888-1957 letters and lines from the film, there to teach phrasing rather than to serve as an archive. Dialect appears as seasoning only; it will not write a whole letter in Teochew.
title_en: Turn plain sentences into Nanyang grandpa-style letters
